question: Simplify: sqrt{2} + (1)/(sqrt{2)} + (1)/(2+sqrt{2)} - (1)/(2-sqrt{2)}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: 1/(a+b) − 1/(a−b) = −2b/(a² − b²)

⇒ Here a = 2, b = √2

⇒ 1/(2+√2) − 1/(2−√2) = −2√2/(4 − 2) = −√2

Now expression = √2 + 1/√2 − √2

⇒ = 1/√2

**∴ Answer = (1)/(sqrt{2)} **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√2 + 1/√2 + 1/(2+√2) − 1/(2−√2)

**Concept Used:**

Rationalization and BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rationalize 1/(2+√2): (2−√2)/(4−2) = (2−√2)/2

⇒ Rationalize 1/(2−√2): (2+√2)/(4−2) = (2+√2)/2

⇒ Expression = √2 + 1/√2 + (2−√2)/2 − (2+√2)/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 + [2−√2 − 2 − √2]/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 + (−2√2)/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 − √2

⇒ = 1/√2

**∴ The correct answer is (1)/(sqrt{2)} .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization

Multiply numerator and denominator by conjugate to remove root from denominator.

Conjugate Identity

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

Simplification Tip

Combine similar radical terms to reduce expression quickly.
